properties.name: MEASURED 2026-10-07: set_artifact_checksums accepted a checksum with design_change_event_id naming a ChangeEvent that did not list the artifact as changed, replied applied: true, and reflow2_check still reported the drift. It counted only after the artifact was added to the change's affected list and the acceptance repeated
properties.statement: Met recording PR #695's design (schema/derived/edge_readers.yaml, art:derived-edge-readers). The batch acceptance replied {applied: true} for all 10 artifacts. reflow2_check then reported "art:derived-edge-readers: checksum_change ... no change in it accepted the new checksum" until add_change_event added the artifact to the change's `affected` and the same acceptance was sent again. The tool said nothing at the first call. Expected: refuse, or at least warn, that the named change does not say it changed this artifact, so the acceptance will not count. Cost: one extra export-and-check round, about five minutes.
